name: cmu
description: CMU Graphics Lab mocap, cgspeed/B. Hahne MotionBuilder-friendly BVH release (2010). Frame 0 is an added T-pose facing +Z; 120 fps; units ~ inches/2.54-ish (scale is derived from leg length).
licence: CMU: free to use, may be included in commercially sold products, may not be resold as data even converted. Credit: 'The data used in this project was obtained from mocap.cs.cmu.edu. The database was created with funding from NSF EIA-0196217.'
notes: Hands are one bone plus stub finger/thumb joints: leave fingers unmapped so the relaxed hand pose is used. LHipJoint/RHipJoint and Neck1 are dropped (world-space retarget keeps their effect). Many takes start and end with the actor standing: trim.
